newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sony's SPTL opens Singapore satellite.
newsitem.headline: Sony's SPTL opens Singapore satellite.

text.p: SPTL Holdings Pte Ltd, a unit of Sony Pictures Entertainment incorporated in Singapore, opened a US$6 million satellite facility here on Friday.
It said in a statement the uplink facility would provide satellite distribution for Sony Pictures Entertainment affiliated programming channels throughout Asia.
"We are like a transmitting station," said general manager Loh Siu Yin. "We are servicing Sony as a data network."
The facility will initially provide services to the two Sony-related satellite channels broadcasting in Asia.
He said SPTL's coverage was across Asia and the facility was already operational.
Sony Pictures Entertainment is the film studio wing of Sony Corp.
